details: Style-class-utils@1.0.0 is a trojanized utility package. The published index.js contains harmless color-conversion helpers, but the postinstall hook (postinstall.js) runs on install. It collects hostname, OS details, process tree, CI/CD environment variables (GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_ACTOR, GITHUB_RUN_ID, CI, RUNNER_NAME), cloud metadata (probes Tencent Cloud and AWS metadata endpoints), and the full environment (including NPM_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS_* credentials). All collected data is base64-encoded and exfiltrated via HTTP GET to pzs5w7ntzhsnepwk564lyfdci3oucl0a[.]oastify[.]com/z?d={data}. The C2 domain is an OAST/Interactsh-style callback service.
